days.title: Northern Shore Peaks and Valleys
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Tjaldanesfell
stops.detail: Many millions of years ago, the Tjaldanes volcano was active there, the remains of which can still be seen in the mountains, including on Tjaldanesfell itself and on the highest mountain in the Westfjords, Kaldbakur.

stops.name: Hrafnseyrarheiði
stops.detail: The steep pass road, which is named Hrafnseyrarheiði after the high plateau it crosses, leads through these mountains up to a height of 552 m and over into the neighboring Dýrafjörður to the north.

stops.name: Lokinhamradalur
stops.detail: On the north shore at the entrance of the fjord, however, lies Lokinhamradalur.

stops.name: Dynjandivogur
stops.detail: It lies approximately in their middle and reaches from northwest to southeast about 30 km inland to the bay Dynjandivogur.

stops.name: Hrafnseyri
stops.detail: Below and slightly east of these mountains lies the hamlet of Hrafnseyri, which has a great past.

stops.name: Dynjandi
stops.detail: The waterfall Dynjandi is located on the southeastern shore of Arnarfjörður.

stops.name: Geirþjófsfjörður
stops.detail: One of these side fjords is, for example, Geirþjófsfjörður.

stops.name: Borgarfjörður
stops.detail: The northern arm in turn splits into Borgarfjörður and Dynjandisvogur.

stops.name: Bíldudalur
stops.detail: The village of Bíldudalur lies on the south shore of the fjord.

stops.name: Selárdalur
stops.detail: From there, a dead-end road leads to the mouth of the fjord up to the farm Selárdalur.
